fontFamilies.fontFamily: Bahnschrift, "DIN Alternate", "Franklin Gothic Medium", "Nimbus Sans Narrow", sans-serif-condensed, sans-serif
fontFamilies.name: Industrial

styles.css: body { overflow-x: clip; --cs-shadow-tint: color-mix(in srgb, var(--wp--preset--color--secondary), #000 60%); --cs-photo-shadow: 0 3px 6px color-mix(in srgb, var(--cs-shadow-tint) 24%, transparent), 0 10px 24px color-mix(in srgb, var(--cs-shadow-tint) 30%, transparent); --cs-photo-shadow-sm: 0 1px 2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--cs-shadow-tint) 13%, transparent), 0 2px 5px color-mix(in srgb, var(--cs-shadow-tint) 17%, transparent); } .wp-site-blocks { display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-height: 100vh; min-height: 100svh; } .wp-site-blocks > footer { margin-top: auto; } .wp-block-site-logo img { filter: grayscale(0.5); transition: filter 0.3s ease; } .wp-block-site-logo a:hover img { filter: none !important; } .cs-soft-rule { border: 0; border-top: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--wp--preset--color--primary) 12%, transparent); background: none; height: 0; opacity: 1; } .wp-block-post-navigation-link.post-navigation-link-next { margin-left: auto; text-align: right; } .cs-comment__avatar img { display: block; border-radius: 50%; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--wp--preset--color--primary) 12%, transparent); } .wp-block-comment-author-name a { text-decoration: none; } .wp-block-comment-author-name a:hover { text-decoration: underline; } .wp-block-comment-content { font-size: 0.95rem; line-height: 1.7; } .wp-block-comments-title { font-size: 1.5rem; } .comment-respond .comment-reply-title { font-family: var(--wp--preset--font-family--cal-sans); font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 600; } .wp-block-post-comments-form .comment-form { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1.5rem; } .wp-block-post-comments-form .comment-form > p { margin: 0; } .wp-block-post-comments-form .comment-form label { display: block; margin-bottom: 0.4rem; } .wp-block-post-comments-form input:not([type=submit]):not([type=checkbox]), .wp-block-post-comments-form textarea { width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--wp--preset--color--primary) 22%, transparent); border-radius: 3px; background: transparent; padding: 0.7em 0.85em; font-family: var(--wp--preset--font-family--system-ui); } .wp-block-post-comments-form input:focus, .wp-block-post-comments-form textarea:focus { outline: none; border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--wp--preset--color--primary) 50%, transparent); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--wp--preset--color--primary) 7%, transparent); } .wp-block-post-comments-form .wp-block-button__link, .wp-block-post-comments-form input[type=submit] { background-color: var(--wp--preset--color--primary); color: var(--wp--preset--color--secondary); border: 1px solid var(--wp--preset--color--primary); border-radius: 3px; padding: 0.7em 1.5em; font-family: var(--wp--preset--font-family--system-ui); transition: opacity 0.2s ease; } .wp-block-post-comments-form .wp-block-button__link:hover, .wp-block-post-comments-form input[type=submit]:hover { opacity: 0.8; } .wp-block-post-content .wp-block-image { margin-top: calc(var(--wp--style--block-gap, 24px) * 2); margin-bottom: calc(var(--wp--style--block-gap, 24px) * 2); } .wp-block-post-content .wp-block-image img { border-radius: 3px; box-shadow: var(--cs-photo-shadow); } .cs-footer-credits, .cs-footer-credits a { color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--wp--preset--color--primary) 55%, transparent); } .wp-block-search .wp-block-search__input { background: var(--wp--preset--color--secondary); border: 1px solid var(--wp--preset--color--primary); color: var(--wp--preset--color--primary); border-radius: 3px; } .wp-block-button__link, .wp-block-search__button, .wp-block-post-comments-form .wp-block-button__link, .wp-block-post-comments-form input[type=submit] { border-radius: 3px; }
